name: Kagura Shinpuuki ~Mamori no Shou~
source:
When the exorcist shrine maiden Yashiro Mamori is asked to go to a village, she is confronted by the sound of a horse neighing, followed by the disappearance of young women.

After hearing the legend of the headless horse that is passed down in the village from the village priest, Mamori believes that the headless horse monster is responsible for the mischief.

In order to save the missing young women, Mamori heads to the mountain where the legend of the horse remains.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1340939]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
当驱魔神社的巫女八代守被要求去一个村庄时，她听到了马嘶声，随后年轻女子失踪了。

真守从村里的祭司那里听到了村里流传的无头马的传说，认为是无头马怪物造成的祸害。

为了拯救失踪的年轻女子，卫前往留有马的传说的山。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1340939]Getchu[/url]]
